entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4468557611977674496: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 195.8563 +/- 0.2535 mas (same row, RUWE 3.71): 5.11 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 333.292, -1068.354 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 4,393 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffdcb7. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,393 K and log g 4.63 (u1 0.759, u2 0.033): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
